record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: IMPIDIMP, MORGREM and GRIMMSNARL (the queued units, the whole evolution line).
record.summary: Single target. SPECIAL 20 / 40 / 80 / 160 (fallback 160) first, then a -20 AP request via addAbilityPower(-20, caster, apBoost 1, cast crit) on the same target, whatever the damage returned (blocked or killing hits do not cancel it). Ordinary path (as MYSTICAL_FIRE): round(-20 x (1 + caster AP/100) x (crit ? critPower : 1)) BEFORE the recipient helpers; Twist Band reverses it, AP floors at -100. A Nullify Bandanna target is routed FIRST to addAttack(-4, apBoost 0, crit false), unaffected by the caster's AP and crit.

effects.scaling: requested amount: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (6th argument apBoost = true); crit multiplier only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: applied amount: the target's SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), ceil, min 1) and later handleDamage modifiers; blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (damage 0, executed; the AP debuff below is still applied). The returned takenDamage is not read by this ability.

declaredRaw.note: requested amount, a constant independent of stars

effects.scaling: requested -20 x (1 + caster AP/100) x (critPower if the cast crit), rounded before the recipient helpers (executed: AP 100 -> -40, crit with AP 100 -> -80, a caster with AP -50 -> -10); a Big Eater Belt on the enemy changes nothing.
effects.resolution: Nullify Bandanna on the TARGET is checked FIRST and converts the RAW -20 to addAttack(round(0.2 x -20) = -4, caster, apBoost 0, crit false): the caster's AP and crit do not scale it (AP 0 and AP 100 + crit both lose 4 ATK; AP stays 0; Nullify + Twist gains 4 ATK), and the AP clamp is skipped. Otherwise TWIST_BAND on the target flips the rounded value into a gain of the same size (+80 executed) and target AP = max(-100, AP + value). The call follows the damage whatever it returned (a Protected or magicBounce target returns 0 and still gets -20; a kill returns 5 and still gets -20).

starBehavior.note: damage is indexed by the casting entity's stars (pokemon.stars - 1); the 4-star entry and the fallback (160) are declared in the tables but unused by the bound baseline classes (Impidimp 1, Morgrem 2, Grimmsnarl 3). The -20 AP change has no star dependence. maxPP is 70 and range 1 for all three.

record.positionalConditions: None beyond needing a target in the caster's range.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No state is kept on the caster: each cast deals damage and applies another -20 (scaled) AP change to the target, so repeated casts on the same target stack until the -100 AP floor. No modes.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested damage 20 / 40 / 80: applied = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit], then SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and shields. Requested AP change -20: stored = round(-20 x (1 + caster AP/100) [x critPower]) then Twist Band / the -100 floor; a Nullify target instead loses 4 ATK. The returned takenDamage is not read.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection) - only the SPECIAL speDef division and the minimum of 1 were read

Consulted: addAbilityPower, applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff and applyTwistBandBuff in app/core/pokemon-entity.ts, handleSpecialDamage, PokemonState.handleDamage and core-mechanics.md sections A, B, H, I. Queue record lists no routing uncertainties and no dependencies.

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (addAbilityPower, the Belt / Twist helpers, addAttack, handleSpecialDamage) and the real SpiritBreakStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units with controlled callbacks (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, section CATCHUP_E3); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed (stand-in target AP 0): the damage-then-AP order, the AP rounding with caster AP and crit before the recipient helpers, the Twist reversal, the -100 floor, the Belt no-op, the Nullify routing to addAttack(-4) unscaled by the caster, and the blocked / killed cases.
